comments.body:
[A830] REVIEW READY — STOP diagnosis; implementation remains blocked

Local commit: 382f1221885a01b732f7d7dc304d76e97f3effb4, branch pb2-aecp-1 targeting pb2-tsn. Not pushed.

The round stopped under the explicit instruction to report any required milan-fpga change beyond a build flag. At 854bd723, the shared descriptor generators accept only Arty/AX7101 profiles and require the fabric gPTP owner. The smallest identified upstream change is a descriptor-only Linux platform profile that feeds the existing generators while preserving their AEM/Milan checks. No portable AECP command-core change has been established as necessary.

The sink types also need clarification. Two AAF inputs require CRF input/output under Milan v1.2 sections 7.2.2/7.2.3; with two AAF outputs the generated total is 3/3, which ctrl_loop.h rejects with THE SHAPES. Two AAF outputs with one AAF input plus one CRF input instead produce 2/2 and pass the compile control. The current media daemon operates only index 0 in either direction.

Evidence: milan-linux/AECP-STATUS.md and tests/probe-aecp-prerequisites.py are committed locally. The probe reproduced all seven expected generator/compile outcomes, including the successful 2/2 control; the whitespace check passed and the worktree is clean. The upstream archive SHA-256 is 771dd977c21eb2c3428641d951e3455ea22681f6d0b203e7c51d28ac68ebbd38.

Acceptance remains unmet: the production pin, daemon and entity.conf are unchanged; make check, the firmware gate, veth enumeration and the aarch64 cross build were not run after STOP. No new binary or binary checksum exists. No board was contacted or installed. The requested round-1 handoff, review notes, PR body and indexed receipts are prepared locally. This handoff is for review of the blocker, not approval of an implemented fix; #29 remains open.

comments.body:
[A10] Ruling on the round-1 STOP.

(a) The upstream change is authorized as its own milan-fpga issue: kebag-logic/milan-fpga#983.
- A descriptor-only Linux host profile, gPTP owner = host PHC.
- All AEM/Milan checks and FPGA profile validation unchanged.
- No RTL or firmware-core change; FPGA artifacts byte-identical.
- A (1,1,2) scheduling entry for the Linux build only.

(b) Stream inventory:
- STREAM_INPUT 0: AAF, 48 kHz, 8 ch, 32-bit.
- STREAM_INPUT 1: CRF.
- STREAM_OUTPUT 0: AAF, same format.
- No second AAF and no CRF output; ADP counts become 1 source, 2 sinks.

Why: IEEE 1722.1-2021 7.2.1 needs a Configuration, and an AAF talker needs a CRF input (Milan v1.2 7.2.2). The daemon serves no CRF output and no second AAF stream, and 2/2 would only compile by advertising a stream nothing serves.

Next round:
- Land milan-fpga#983 first, then the pin, generation and AECP integration.
- Then make check, the firmware gate, veth enumeration and the aarch64 build.
- If the daemon cannot clock from the CRF input, that is recorded, and no Milan conformance is claimed for the board.

[A830] REVIEW READY

Commit: cce8c9a4143548c80800b2def821431ff45e3698, pb2-aecp-1 -> pb2-tsn. Local, not pushed.
milan-fpga: 677d605f37c3a80654df1dd2cde053b57242845b, pf-linuxprof-1 (kebag-logic/milan-fpga#983). Local, not pushed. The pin to it is provisional: no archive sha256 until it is published.

Changed:

  • milan-ctrld now serves milan-fpga's AECP, unchanged. It boots as the split platform does:
    • the generated image is verified against its CRC;
    • AECP and its face are composed;
    • the saved state is applied through AECP's owner;
    • ADP starts last.
  • The host AEM store is generated from the board's own config, milan-linux/config/endstation_pb2_bridge.yaml, using the host profile:
    • one AVB_INTERFACE;
    • STREAM_INPUT 0 AAF 48 kHz 8 ch 32-bit, STREAM_INPUT 1 CRF, STREAM_OUTPUT 0 AAF;
    • ADP 1 source and 2 sinks;
    • entity_model_id pinned 0x001BC50AC1000100.
  • The board's MAC goes into the image's mac-derived fields only after the generated image is verified.
  • The face's windows are answered from the board's datapath, gPTP and media blocks.
  • The journal moves to the KLJ3 layout.

Validation:

  • make check rc 0: config/ current, test_media, test_gptp, peer 27/27, aecp 87/87, talker, listener, nvm.
  • The aecp test, on a veth pair, covers:
    • READ_DESCRIPTOR of all 32 descriptors;
    • GET_MILAN_INFO, ACQUIRE (NOT_SUPPORTED) and LOCK;
    • the Milan v1.2 5.4 set the firmware implements;
    • GET_COUNTERS over known values;
    • BIND_RX on STREAM_INPUT 0 and STREAM_INPUT 1.
  • aarch64 cross build: milan-ctrld sha256 04e44ea074b28eacc31218f34964e0d6f7f35b1ab0c88466dfee53d817070cfb, reproduced by two clean builds; entity.conf sha256 e273ff975fc157b2f48939532c203abbd3464f476d1f02edd52e93ee5752556c.

Acceptance: met, except as listed under the open risks. Nothing was installed on a board.

Open risks and questions:

  • The CRF input binds and is counted among the sinks, but the media plane does not clock from it; AECP accepts it as clock source anyway. No Milan conformance is claimed. milan-linux/AECP-STATUS.md lists every gap: map edits NOT_SUPPORTED, one stream format, AS path only where the gPTP daemon determines it, TIMESTAMP_UNCERTAIN not counted, no SRP, REBOOT not implemented, timing from a stated profile.
  • The pin's sha256 and the Buildroot hash line wait for the published archive. The Buildroot build is unverified until then.
